headline: Public hearings on affordable housing at 54-56 Margin Street and Salem High School campus work at 77 Wilson Street.
summary: Public hearings cover wetlands permits for housing and shelter beds, Salem High School site work, Willow Beach sewer supports, and four other sites. Updates on several older projects follow, along with a vice-chair vote.
items: 54-56 Margin Street, 5 High Street, 20-24 Endicott Street (#64-832): continued public hearing on Harborlight Homes Notice of Intent to redevelop parcels into affordable housing and shelter beds with services
0 Waite St (#64-836): continued public hearing on Massachusetts Electric Company Notice of Intent for underground cable removal

77 Wilson Street (#64-XXX): public hearing on City of Salem Notice of Intent for enabling work for future Salem High School campus development, including ledge removal, parking lot changes, and partial demolition
Willow Ave Beach (#64-838): public hearing on City of Salem Notice of Intent to replace existing sewer line supports
260 Canal St bike path: public hearing on Marblehead Municipal Light Department Request for Determination of Applicability for in-kind light pole replacement and new stub poles
92 Fort Ave: public hearing on Naomi Cottrell Request for Determination of Applicability for invasive species management at Cat Cove
46 Columbus Ave: public hearing on City of Salem Request for Determination of Applicability for sandbags on the beach side of the seawall
23 Strongwater Crossing (#64-746): request for partial certificate of compliance
25 Strongwater Crossing (#64-740): request for partial certificate of compliance
4 Nurse Way (#64-819): request for certificate of compliance
Forest River Conservation Area footbridge: update
Conservation Commission Vice-Chair: discussion and vote

November 17th, 2026 Salem Conservation Commission Agenda | Page 1  
  CITY OF SALEM 
CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
 
NOTICE OF MEETING 
 
Notice is hereby given that a meeting of the Salem Conservation Commission will be held on November 17th  
at 6:30 p.m. via remote participation in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2025. 
Important Announcement: 
The public may participate, listen and/or view this meeting while in progress via the remote participation 
platform Zoom, through any one of the following ways: 
 
• Follow this direct link  or go to https://zoom.us/join and enter Webinar ID 825 6376 4692 and Passcode 
653233. 
 
• Dial toll-free number 1-833-548-0282. When prompted, enter Webinar ID and Passcode and follow the 
instructions to join the meeting. 
Providing Public Comment Remotely During the Meeting: 
Members of the public attending this meeting virtually will be allowed to make comments during the portion 
of a public hearing designated for each item. Members of the public will be asked to use the virtual “Raise 
Hand” function in Zoom to indicate that they would like to provide comment through on of the following ways: 
 
• Enter *9 on phone dial pad to raise your hand if you are using the toll-free phone number, proceed to 
enter *6 to unmute when called upon to speak. 
• Click the “raise hand” button if you are using the Zoom application on a computer or phone. 
 
Providing Public Comment Before the Meeting: 
Members of the public may email their comment no later than four hours before the start of the meeting to: 
rvresilovic@salem.com. 
 
The Zoom webinar will open 15 minutes before the start of the meeting to allow participants to connect and 
practice the audio and raise hand functions. 
 
Meeting Materials 
May be accessed through this direct link or at salemma.gov/conservation-commission.
November 17th, 2026 Salem Conservation Commission Agenda | Page 2  
MEETING AGENDA 
A. ROLL CALL 
B. REGULAR AGENDA  
A. 54-56 Margin Street,  5 High Street, 20-24 Endicott Street  #64-832 – Continuance of Public Hearing - 
Notice of Intent for Harborlight Homes, for a redevelopment of multiple parcels into affordable 
housing and shelter beds with service.   The site is located at 54-56 Margin Street, 7 High Street & 
20-24 Endicott Street (Map 25, Lots 595 & 597) within an area subject to protection under the 
Wetlands Protection Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation 
Ordinance.    
B. 0 Waite St - #64-836- Continuance of Public Hearing – Notice of Intent for James Rynes, 
Massachusetts Electric Company, for proposed underground cable removal work. The site is located 
at 0 Waite St (Map 36, Lot 234) within an area subject to protection under the Wetlands Protection 
Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation Ordinance.   
C. 77 Wilson Street - #64-XXX- Public Hearing - Notice of Intent for Dominick Pangallo, City of Salem, 
for the on-site enabling work for the future development of the Salem High School campus. This 
work includes ledge removal, modifications to the northern parking lot, demolition of the existing 
automative building and partial demolition of the main school building.  The site is located at 77 
Wilson St, Salem High School Campus, (Map 13 & 14, Lot 213) within an area subject to protection 
under the Wetlands Protection Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation 
Ordinance.   
D. Willow Ave Beach - #64-838- Public Hearing - Notice of Intent for the City of Salem, City Engineer 
for replacing the existing sewer line supports at Willow Beach. The site is located at Willow Beach 
(Map 33, Lot 750) within an area subject to protection under the Wetlands Protection Act MGL 
c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation Ordinance.  
E. 260 Canal St bike path – Public Hearing - Request for Determination of Applicability Jonathan Blair, 
Marblehead Municipal Light Department, for in-kind replacement of light poles and installation of 
new stub poles. The site is located at 260 Canal Street along the Salem bike path (Map 32, Lot 32) 
within an area subject to protection under the Wetlands Protection Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem 
Wetlands Protection and Conservation Ordinance.   
F. 92 Fort Ave- Public Hearing- Request for Determination of Applicability for Naomi Cottrell, for 
invasive species management along coastal bank and within cracks of stone revetment at Cat Cove. 
The site is located at 92 Fort Ave, Cat Cove (Map 44, Lot 37) within an area subject to protection 
under the Wetlands Protection Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation 
Ordinance. 
G. 46 Columbus Ave – Public Hearing - Request for Determination of Applicability for Ray Jodoin, City 
of Salem, for the placement of sandbags on the beach side of the Columbus Ave seawall. The site is 
located at 46 Columbus Ave, at the seawall, (Map 46, Lot 146) within an area subject to protection 
under the Wetlands Protection Act MGL c.131§40 and Salem Wetlands Protection and Conservation 
Ordinance.   
C.  OLD | NEW BUSINESS CONTINUED 
1. 23 Strongwater Crossing- #64-746- Request for Partial Certificate of Compliance 
2. 25 Strongwater Crossing- #64-740- Request for Partial Certificate of Compliance 
3. 4 Nurse Way- #64-819- Request for Certificate of Compliance 
4. 115 Swampscott Rd - update 
5. 159 Marlborough Rd- violation update 
6. Forest River Conservation Area footbridge update 
7. Conservation Commission Vice-Chair discussion and vote 
8. Conservation Commission 2027 meeting schedule
November 17th, 2026 Salem Conservation Commission Agenda | Page 3  
 
D. MEETING MINUTES  
1. August 18, 2026 meeting minutes 
2. September 17, 2026 meeting minutes
